messages:
arjun: Quick heads-up 1 I'm landing a docs PR that unifies quota header examples across SDKs and adds a concise analytics export sample for customers wiring dashboards. Need a quick check on wording + the console panel URL to paste in onboarding.

lina: Drop the snippets here, I'll skim for header names and response shape.

arjun: JS snippet (compact):

arjun: ```js
// per-request tier example
const r = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-13b',
  input: 'Summarize the changelog',
  headers: {
    'X-Redwood-Tier': 'team-plus', // preferred tier (case-insensitive)
    'X-Redwood-Fallback': 'auto-economy'
  }
});
console.log(r);
```

arjun: And a minimal curl example for copy-paste: 

arjun: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "X-Redwood-Tier: team-plus" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"Summarize the changelog"}'
```

lina: LGTM. Please also include a short example of the analytics export format so CSMs can wire Grafana/PBI. Show the new field name "usage_tier" and how legacy burst credits surface.

arjun: Adding export example: 

arjun: ```json
{"export":[{"meter":"tokens","usage_tier":"team-plus","count":14250},{"meter":"requests","usage_tier":"team-plus","count":84},{"meter":"burst_credits","usage_tier":"legacy-grant","count":30}]}
```

lina: Perfect. One editorial request: avoid the word "slab" in the new docs; use "legacy-grant" or "legacy-slab" only in historical notes. Also call out that header names are accepted case-insensitively and some SDKs accept underscores.

finance-bot: FYI billing schema changed 2026-01-05: "tier_label" -> "usage_tier". If customers still send the old field they might get a mapping warning.

arjun: Good to know, I'll add a migration note and a tiny CLI command for customers to dry-run quota consolidation: `redwood-cli migrate-quotas --org $ORG --dry-run`.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 1 reviewers: @lina @arjun

lina: I'll review tonight, will flag any wording changes. Add the console panel link template: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboard/usage_migration_panel?org={{org_id}} and mention that it requires console:usage-read role.

arjun: thanks all. I'll push the update with the panel link + analytics snippet and ping once CI passes. :thumbsup:
